reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 3 restrictions (including 3(e) and 3(g)) are conventional licence-scope limits on use of the Work, not restrictions on the businesses Customer may operate or the products it may buy or build.
The service-bureau limit in 3(g) is a use-of-licensed-Work restriction with an affiliate carve-out, not a field-of-use or competing-product covenant, so it does not trigger the NONCOMPETE rule.
Section 19 (p0133) is a mutual one-year employee non-solicitation, correctly characterised as outside this rule's scope (non-compete/field-of-use).
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
